instruction_summary: 2026 model-refresh tick extending the prior geometry-of-truth living-update: reuse all 2023-2025 per-model results and ADD the newest 2026 models to the truth-direction ladder, extracting residual activations via transformers output_hidden_states (nnsight cannot wrap the qwen3_5 / gemma4_unified multimodal architectures), training the same mass-mean/LR/CCS probes, and re-aggregating old+new plus extending the over-time figure to 2026.

steps.description: Read the original 001 methodology, replication artifacts, and prior 001 living-update results/scripts; confirmed the C3 anchor baselines from disk (Llama-2-13B L14 oracle:False MM 0.9746, LR 0.9718, CCS 0.9774)

Set up 003 workspace: copied 001 workspace/codebase scripts, symlinked the 5 prior new-model acts dirs into 003/acts (reuse DONE), copied the seed-0 capped datasets, staged 001 generalization_followup.json + flip_rates.json as the old-model baseline (read from disk, not recomputed)
Built a fresh uv venv (py3.11) with transformers 5.17.0 + torch 2.14.0+cu130, because the 001 venv (transformers 4.57.1) does NOT know model_type qwen3_5 / gemma4_unified
steps.command: uv venv .venv && uv pip install torch==2.14.0 transformers==5.17.0 accelerate pandas numpy matplotlib

steps.description: Smoke-tested Qwen3.5-9B-Base with plain transformers (AutoModelForImageTextToText): load + one forward + one activation read. Decoder is at m.model.language_model.layers (NOT m.language_model as the instruction stated); output_hidden_states[L+1][:,-1,:] matches a forward hook on layers[L] EXACTLY (max abs diff 0.0). 32 layers, hidden 4096, hidden_states len 33.

Extracted last-token bf16 residual activations for the 8 datasets at the 6 sweep layers (relative depths {0.25,0.375,0.4,0.5,0.625,0.75}) for Qwen3.5-9B-Base via output_hidden_states, left padding, N<=1000 seed-0 capped

Smoke-tested + extracted gemma-4-12B (Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration, 48 layers, hidden 3840, sweep [12,18,19,24,30,36], probe 19) with the same generic output_hidden_states backend; weights were fully present (23 GB single-file safetensors)

Ran probes (LR/MM/CCS medleys + oracle) verbatim from probes.py over the common 8-dataset grid at every sweep layer for BOTH 2026 models, selecting val-best layer per model; recorded C3/C19/oracle at both best-val and 0.4-depth. Old models read from the 001 result on disk and merged (not recomputed).

Ran the cheap causal flip-rate analog (single MM cities+neg_cities direction, add/subtract over intervene..probe layers, magnitude sweep 1x/2x/4x/8x) for Qwen3.5-9B-Base using transformers forward HOOKS (nnsight cannot wrap qwen3_5)
Rebuilt the three figures extended to the 2026 point(s): over-time (C3 vs release era, both 2026 models ringed, 0.4-depth shown as x), probe-acc-vs-scale, PCA cities grid

gemma-4-12b.note: within-dataset separability strong (oracle 0.95-0.98) but cross-dataset C3 generalization FAILS at the paper 0.4-depth layer and only partially recovers deep; architecture-dependent limitation

comparison_to_original.quantity: C3 headline cross-dataset generalization (larger+smaller -> sp_en_trans), MM probe, at paper 0.4-depth layer
comparison_to_original.note: Newest Qwen (Mar 2026) reproduces the paper's headline finding perfectly and beyond; gemma-4-12B does NOT generalize cross-dataset at the canonical layer despite strong within-dataset separability.

comparison_to_original.quantity: C3 MM at each model's validation-best layer
comparison_to_original.note: Qwen3.5 matches the anchor at best-val too; gemma recovers only partially even at its best layer.

comparison_to_original.quantity: C3 LR / CCS at best-val layer
comparison_to_original.note: LR/CCS confirm the split: perfect on Qwen3.5, near-chance cross-dataset on gemma-4.

comparison_to_original.followup: Qwen3.5-9B-Base 0.8832 (highest in the whole ladder); gemma-4-12B 0.8362 at deep L36 but 0.4822 at the 0.4-depth L19
comparison_to_original.note: Qwen3.5 sets the ladder record; gemma's off-diagonal is only high at deep layers.
Truth is linearly separable WITHIN each dataset for both 2026 models, including gemma; gemma's failure is specifically the cross-dataset transfer.

comparison_to_original.quantity: Causal single-direction MM flip-rate (analog of C2/C17)
comparison_to_original.followup: Qwen3.5-9B-Base: ~0 at 1x (saturated readout, like the whole Qwen family in 001), but 99.4% TRUE->FALSE at 2x and 100% at 4x with the SAME direction; FALSE->TRUE never flips
comparison_to_original.note: Cheap single-direction analog via transformers hooks; confirms the MM direction is causally load-bearing (TRUE->FALSE) once the natural under-magnitude is corrected. Not the full 12-cell NIE table.

deviations: Instruction said the text decoder is m.language_model; in transformers 5.17.0 it is m.model.language_model (for both qwen3_5 and gemma4_unified). Found by module introspection; the output_hidden_states residual-stream reading works exactly as instructed and matches a forward hook on layers[L] to 0.0.

A fresh venv (transformers 5.17.0) was required because the 001 venv (transformers 4.57.1) does not support model_type qwen3_5 / gemma4_unified. Old-model results were REUSED verbatim from the 001 living-update on disk (not recomputed); only the 2026 models were computed this session.

nnsight was NOT used for the 2026 models (it cannot wrap qwen3_5 / gemma4_unified); extraction uses transformers output_hidden_states and the causal analog uses transformers forward hooks, per the instruction.

gemma-4-12B was added as an optional SECOND 2026 point (weights fully present, 23 GB, hookable). Its causal flip-rate was NOT run (optional; interpretation is muddy given gemma's weak cross-dataset generalization).
The causal flip-rate is a cheap single-MM-direction analog of C2/C17, not the full per-layer/per-token 12-cell NIE Table 2.
New-model activations capped at N<=1000/dataset (seed 0); C19 computed on the common 8-dataset grid, matching the 001 protocol and the anchor's common-grid recompute.
